en.title: Withdrawing Tournament Revenue
en.excerpt: A clear, friendly walkthrough on how tournament organizers can securely manage accumulated registration revenue and request payouts directly to their bank account.
en.content:
When archers register and pay their entry fees online through Archeris, funds are securely collected and aggregated in your organization's digital wallet. This guide explains how to check your available balance, verify your security credentials, and request bank payouts smoothly.

Organizer Wallet & Revenue Balance

Your Organizer Wallet provides a transparent, real-time summary of all tournament revenue:

  • Available Balance: The total settled net revenue available for immediate withdrawal to your bank account.
  • Pending Clearance: Funds from recent digital transactions currently clearing settlement gateways.
  • Total Withdrawn: Cumulative lifetime payouts successfully transferred to your organization's bank accounts.

Financial Security & Access Control

To ensure strict financial confidentiality and safeguard your club's earnings:

  • Password Lock: Accessing the Balance / Wallet page (/dashboard/organizer/balance) requires entering your account password to unlock sensitive balance amounts and bank details.
  • Role Authorization: Only designated organization administrators with financial permissions can unlock balance pages and initiate withdrawals.

How to Request a Payout

Follow these simple steps to disburse tournament earnings to your registered bank account:

  1. Navigate to Balance / Keuangan in your Organizer Dashboard.
  2. Enter your account password on the security overlay to unlock your balance view.
  3. Click the Tarik Saldo / Request Withdrawal button to open the payout modal.
  4. Choose your destination bank account from your pre-registered organization bank accounts.
  5. Enter the amount you wish to withdraw (minimum withdrawal amount is Rp 50,000).
  6. Review the destination account details carefully and click Submit Withdrawal to confirm.

Settlement Timelines & Bank Processing

Once submitted, withdrawal requests undergo fast-track automated disbursement:

  • Processing Time: Payouts are generally processed and credited to your bank account within 1 to 2 business days (excluding weekends and public bank holidays).
  • Supported Banks: Instant and clearing bank networks across Indonesia, including BCA, Bank Mandiri, BNI, BRI, Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI), CIMB Niaga, and Permata Bank.
  • Status Tracking: The status in your withdrawal table will update in real time from Pending to Completed once the interbank transfer finishes.

Transaction Ledger & Financial Audits

Maintain spotless financial transparency for your committee and stakeholders:

  • Mutation Ledger: Every entry fee payment, platform fee, and withdrawal is recorded in an immutable ledger with timestamps and reference IDs.
  • Downloadable Payout Receipts: Click on any completed payout row to download an official PDF disbursement voucher for club treasurer records and audit compliance.
